title: Vision 2040 for a thriving fisheries and aquaculture sector
content: The European Commission has set out its vision for fisheries and aquaculture towards 2040. This outlines the course for fishers, aquaculture producers and local communities over the next 15 years to ensure a strong, competitive and sustainable blue economy.

title: An EU strategy for a rapidly changing Arctic
content: The Arctic is changing fast. From climate change to geopolitical tensions, there are challenges reshaping its security and economic landscape. The Commission has put forward a strategy for the Arctic - a framework of cooperation that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core.

title: Apply now to be a European Climate Pact Ambassador!
content: If you’re committed to informing and inspiring climate action in your community, now is your chance to become a European Climate Pact Ambassador. All you need to demonstrate is that you’re ready to motivate others to take climate action and be a changemaker. Apply by 31 October 2026.

title: Staying one step ahead of breast cancer, our talk with Europa Donna
content: Pink October is breast cancer awareness month. This year we had a chat with the Executive Director of the largest European breast cancer patient advocacy organisation. Find out what she said and learn more about what the EU is doing to support breast cancer prevention and care.

title: AI adoption more than doubles in almost every EU strategic sector
content: According to a new EU analysis, the share of firms using AI in the EU’s 10 strategic sectors grew from 7% in 2021 to 18% in 2025. Media, energy and electronic sectors lead in AI adoption, while mobility, tourism and agri-food lag behind. This uneven growth is driven mainly by general-purpose AI.
